description.html: Half a meter of length, 35 cm of width and 35 cm of height: 1750 cm² of floor and about 61 liters. On the back is a 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam, and ventilation is through a mesh vent. The model fits on a dresser 40 cm deep. It opens at the front, by sliding the glass panels to the side.

An adult leopard gecko gets enough floor for a proper temperature gradient: heating on the left third, a cool hide on the right. Crested and gargoyle geckos use the background and branches up to 35 cm of height. A juvenile corn snake can stay here until it passes 60 to 70 cm in length. Day geckos and smaller lizards bask on the ledges of the background.

We list the version without a background, with more free depth, as the 50x35x35. Larger models with a 3D background are the 60x35x40 and 70x50x50. A build to your dimensions takes 7 to 14 days, and delivery is by courier. You choose the film pattern and the background relief when ordering.
